hero_title: A Ghanaian Adventist community on the island of Ireland
hero_text: We are a growing community of Ghanaian Seventh-day Adventists and friends, spread across Ireland and Northern Ireland. We come together through the year to worship, to keep our faith and culture alive, and to look after one another.

stats.label: We gather several times a year
Everyone is welcome to join us

pillars.title: Worship together
pillars.text: We meet through the year for Sabbath worship, prayer and study — in English and in Twi, with the hymns and harmonies we grew up on.

pillars.title: Stay connected
pillars.text: Between gatherings we keep in touch. For many members this is the nearest thing to family on this island, and it works quietly, all year round.

pillars.title: Support one another
pillars.text: Practical help for members finding their feet in Ireland, and real support in bereavement, illness or hardship.

quote: For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.
